findings.title: Static export conflicts with mutable dynamic routes
findings.next: Deploy with normal Next server runtime and keep build-time API fallback warnings out of production monitoring noise.

findings.title: Root public shell is not structurally isolated from admin
findings.next: Keep public/admin route groups separate as remaining pages are refactored.

findings.title: Admin trusts fake localStorage token while backend uses cookie
findings.next: Continue avoiding bearer-token-only admin flows; all protected pages should rely on cookie session checks.

findings.title: UTC date helpers can shift clinic dates
findings.next: Finish replacing UTC date construction with Asia/Kolkata clinic-day helpers and add India boundary tests.

findings.title: Frontend appointment fee is hard-coded separately from backend
findings.next: Expose appointment quote/fee from backend and remove independent frontend fee constants.

findings.title: ABHA/Aadhaar are collected and placed in free-text notes
findings.next: Verify current forms do not collect ABHA/Aadhaar; if collection exists, remove or move to explicit consented structured fields.

findings.title: Privacy text does not match actual collection and includes unverified claims/contact
findings.next: Legal/privacy review must compare policy text against actual data collection before production sign-off.

findings.title: Payment confirmation lacks robust pending/retry/recovery
findings.next: Finish explicit pending/retry/recovery UX and verify with provider status API race cases.

findings.title: Clinic facts are duplicated/inconsistent
findings.next: Use central settings source for clinic identity, address, phone, and policy references.

findings.title: /admin/operations duplicates other admin routes
findings.next: Deprecate or redirect /admin/operations after dashboard, appointments, payments, notifications, and leads replacements are complete.

findings.title: Dashboard downloads broad lists to calculate counts
findings.next: Keep dashboard backed by aggregate queries and watch query duration metrics.

findings.title: Admin collections lack consistent pagination
findings.next: Finish pagination for package orders and package management surfaces.

findings.title: Large checkout and calendar modules are difficult to test
findings.next: Extract reducers, date helpers, and smaller components before adding deeper integration tests.

findings.title: Tables rely on horizontal scroll
findings.next: Continue using table/card responsive pairs for remaining admin collections.

findings.title: body_md renders as pre-wrapped text, not safe Markdown
findings.next: Add safe Markdown rendering with allowed tags and reviewer metadata.

findings.title: Structured data and links hard-code clinic facts or slugs
findings.next: Move structured data and service links to verified central settings/content records.
